license_required.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice, or who advertises or holds himself or herself out as practicing, any system or mode of treating the sick or afflicted in this state, or who diagnoses, treats, operates for, or prescribes for any ailment, blemish, deformity, disease, disfigurement, disorder, injury, or other physical or mental condition of any person, without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter … is guilty of a public offense

issuing_authority.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

name.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

type.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California that consists of 15 members, 7 of whom shall be public members.

umbrella_agency.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California

degree_required.value: Graduate of an approved medical school (M.D. or D.O. degree)
degree_required.quote: A diploma issued by an approved medical school. The requirements of the school shall have been at the time of granting the diploma in no degree less than those required under this chapter

accrediting_body.value: Liaison Committee on Medical Education (LCME), Committee on Accreditation of Canadian Medical Schools, or Commission on Osteopathic College Accreditation; foreign schools evaluated by ECFMG or listed on WFME/FAIMER World Directory
accrediting_body.quote: Medical schools accredited by a national accrediting agency approved by the board and recognized by the United States Department of Education shall be deemed approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: A diploma issued by an approved medical school.

school_approval_basis.quote: Medical schools accredited by a national accrediting agency approved by the board and recognized by the United States Department of Education shall be deemed approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: A diploma issued by an approved medical school. The requirements of the school shall have been at the time of granting the diploma in no degree less than those required under this chapter

required.quote: before a physician's and surgeon's license may be issued, each applicant … shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has received credit for at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada or 24 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of foreign medical schools

experience_source.quote: before a physician's and surgeon's license may be issued, each applicant … shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has received credit for at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada or 24 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of foreign medical schools

duration.value: 12 months (US/Canada graduates); 24 months (foreign medical school graduates)
duration.quote: at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada or 24 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of foreign medical schools approved by the board pursuant to Section 2084 other than Canadian medical schools

kind.quote: The postgraduate training required by this section shall be obtained in a postgraduate training program approved by the Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME) in the United States, the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada (RCPSC) in Canada, or the College of Family Physicians of Canada (CFPC) in Canada.

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) – all steps
exams.notes: Step 3 limited to 4 attempts; passing scores valid 10 years. Board may designate equivalent examinations.
exams.quote: An applicant shall have obtained a passing score on all parts of Step 3 of the United States Medical Licensing Examination within not more than four attempts in order to be eligible for a physician's and surgeon's certificate.

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME) diplomate examination
exams.notes: Diplomates of the National Board of Medical Examiners may be exempt from the written examination if they meet the requirements of Section 2151.
exams.quote: An applicant who is a diplomate of the National Board of Medical Examiners shall not be required to take the written examination prescribed by this article, provided such applicant meets the requirements of Section 2151.

interval_years.quote: All physician and surgeon's certificates … shall expire at 12 midnight on the last day of the month in which the license was issued during the second year of a two-year term commencing from the date of issuance

required.quote: the board shall adopt and administer standards for the continuing education of those licensees. … The board shall require each licensed physician and surgeon to demonstrate satisfaction of the continuing education requirements at intervals of not less than four nor more than six years.

value: Cultural and linguistic competency (on and after July 1, 2006, in all direct patient care CME)
Implicit bias training (on and after January 1, 2022, in all direct patient care CME)
Pain management and treatment of terminally ill/dying patients – one-time 12-credit-hour course
Risks of addiction associated with use of Schedule II drugs (for licensees on/after January 1, 2019)
Geriatric medicine (general internists and family physicians with >25% patients age 65+ must complete at least 20% of mandatory CME hours in geriatric medicine, dementia, or care of older patients)
topical_requirements.quote: All physicians and surgeons shall complete a mandatory continuing education course in the subjects of pain management and the treatment of terminally ill and dying patients.

available.quote: The board shall issue a physician's and surgeon's certificate to an applicant who meets all of the following requirements: (a) The applicant holds an unlimited license as a physician and surgeon in another state or states, or in a Canadian province or Canadian provinces

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an unrestricted out-of-state or Canadian provincial license for at least 4 years; pass an equivalent examination; no disciplinary history; meet postgraduate training requirements; and either (1) hold ABMS specialty board certification plus 1 year postgraduate training, or (2) have 2 years postgraduate training, or (3) have 1 year postgraduate training plus pass a clinical competency exam. Alternative endorsement for NBME diplomates available under Section 2151. Expedited pathway under Section 2135.5 for applicants with 4+ years unrestricted practice and ABMS certification.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a physician's and surgeon's certificate to an applicant who meets all of the following requirements: (a) The applicant holds an unlimited license as a physician and surgeon in another state or states, or in a Canadian province

exists.quote: There is in the Department of Consumer Affairs a Medical Board of California that consists of 15 members, 7 of whom shall be public members.

national_certification.value: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS) member boards; National Board of Medical Examiners (NBME)
national_certification.quote: certified by a specialty board that is a member board of the American Board of Medical Specialties

national_association.value: Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education (ACGME); California Medical Association; Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education
national_association.quote: Educational activities that meet the content standards set forth in this section and are accredited by the California Medical Association or the Accreditation Council for Continuing Medical Education may be deemed by the Division of Licensing to meet its continuing medical education standards.

regulatory_model.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice … without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter … is guilty of a public offense

credential_type.quote: The Division of Licensing shall issue one form of certificate to all physicians and surgeons licensed by the board which shall be designated as a 'physician's and surgeon's certificate.'

is_mandatory.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice … without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter … is guilty of a public offense

title_protection.quote: Any person who uses in any sign, business card, or letterhead, or, in an advertisement, the words 'doctor' or 'physician,' the letters or prefix 'Dr.,' the initials 'M.D.' or 'D.O.,' … without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, and unsuspended certificate as a physician and surgeon under this chapter, is guilty of a misdemeanor.

scope_protection.quote: any person who practices or attempts to practice … without having at the time of so doing a valid, unrevoked, or unsuspended certificate as provided in this chapter … is guilty of a public offense

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or conspiring to violate any provision of the Medical Practice Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate any provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross negligence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Two or more negligent acts or omissions constituting repeated negligence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Repeated negligent acts. To be repeated, there must be two or more negligent acts or omissions.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption substantially related to the duties of a physician and surgeon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving dishonesty or corruption that is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action or conduct that would have warranted denial of a certificate
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action or conduct that would have warranted the denial of a certificate.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure without good cause to attend and participate in a board interview as a subject of investigation within 30 days of notification
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure by a certificate holder, in the absence of good cause, to attend and participate in an interview by the board no later than 30 calendar days after being notified by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any action intended to cause a patient to rescind consent to release medical records to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any action of the licensee, or another person acting on behalf of the licensee, intended to cause their patient or their patient's authorized representative to rescind consent to release the patient's medical records to the board or the Department of Consumer Affairs, Health Quality Investigation Unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or other person to prevent reporting or testifying about a licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dissuading, intimidating, or tampering with a patient, witness, or any person in an attempt to prevent them from reporting or testifying about a licensee.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of any offense substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of a physician and surgeon constitutes unprofessional conduct within the meaning of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any federal or state statute or regulation regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The conviction of a charge of violating any federal statutes or regulations or any statute or regulation of this state, regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any federal or state statute or regulation regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of any federal statute or federal regulation or any of the statutes or regulations of this state regulating dangerous drugs or controlled substances constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of controlled substances or alcohol to an extent dangerous or injurious, or to an extent that impairs safe practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The use or prescribing for or administering to himself or herself, of any controlled substance; or the use of any of the dangerous drugs specified in Section 4022, or of alcoholic beverages, to the extent, or in such a manner as to be dangerous or injurious to the licensee, or to any other person or to the public, or to the extent that such use impairs the ability of the licensee to practice medicine safely

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or signing a false certificate or document related to the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or signing any certificate or other document directly or indirectly related to the practice of medicine or podiatry which falsely represents the existence or nonexistence of a state of facts, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Altering or modifying a medical record with fraudulent intent, or creating a false medical record with fraudulent intent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Altering or modifying the medical record of any person, with fraudulent intent, or creating any false medical record, with fraudulent intent, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, aiding, or abetting an unlicensed or suspended/revoked person to engage in the practice of medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The employing, directly or indirectly, the aiding, or the abetting of any unlicensed person or any suspended, revoked, or unlicensed practitioner to engage in the practice of medicine … constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain adequate and accurate patient records for at least seven years after last date of service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The failure of a physician and surgeon to maintain adequate and accurate records relating to the provision of services to their patients for at least seven years after the last date of service to a patient constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in violation of Section 17500 (false or misleading advertising)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertising in violation of Section 17500, relating to false or misleading advertising, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising the practice of medicine without using the licensee's own name or approved fictitious name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any advertising of the practice of medicine in which the licensee fails to use his or her own name or approved fictitious name constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employment of runners, cappers, steerers, or others to procure patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Except as otherwise allowed by law, the employment of runners, cappers, steerers, or other persons to procure patients constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing medicine while under the influence of narcotic drugs or alcohol to an extent that impairs safe practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: No licensee shall practice medicine while under the influence of any narcotic drug or alcohol to such an extent as to impair his or her ability to conduct the practice of medicine with safety to the public and his or her patients.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful, unauthorized violation of professional confidence constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs without an appropriate prior examination and medical indication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing, or furnishing dangerous drugs as defined in Section 4022 without an appropriate prior examination and a medical indication, constitutes unprofessional conduct.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a certificate by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the Senior Assistant Attorney General of the Health Quality Enforcement Section shall initiate action against any licensee who obtains a certificate by fraud or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, or other discipline by another state or federal authority that would have been grounds for discipline in California
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, or other discipline, restriction, or limitation imposed by another state upon a license or certificate to practice medicine issued by that state … shall constitute grounds for disciplinary action for unprofessional conduct against the licensee in this state.

insurance_required.quote: it is unprofessional conduct for a physician and surgeon to fail to provide adequate security by liability insurance, or by participation in an interindemnity trust, for claims by patients arising out of surgical procedures performed outside of a general acute care hospital

establishment_regulation_required.quote: no physician and surgeon shall perform procedures in an outpatient setting using anesthesia, except local anesthesia or peripheral nerve blocks, or both, complying with the community standard of practice … unless the setting is specified in Section 1248.1.

definition_quote.value: The physician's and surgeon's certificate authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.
definition_quote.quote: The physician's and surgeon's certificate authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.

value: use of drugs or devices in or upon human beings
severing or penetrating tissues of human beings (surgical)
use of any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions
methods_authorized.quote: The physician's and surgeon's certificate authorizes the holder to use drugs or devices in or upon human beings and to sever or penetrate the tissues of human beings and to use any and all other methods in the treatment of diseases, injuries, deformities, and other physical and mental conditions.

drug_authority.value: A physician and surgeon may prescribe, dispense, or administer prescription drugs, including prescription controlled substances, for treatment of pain or any medical condition, including intractable pain; may prescribe, dispense, or administer controlled substances for substance use disorder treatment under specified conditions.
drug_authority.quote: A physician and surgeon may prescribe for, or dispense or administer to, a person under their treatment for a medical condition dangerous drugs or prescription controlled substances for the treatment of pain or a condition causing pain, including, but not limited to, intractable pain.

value: Inactive (certificate placed on inactive status during misdemeanor incarceration)
Retired (exempt from renewal fees and CME; may not practice)
Postgraduate Training License (issued to medical school graduates enrolled in approved postgraduate training programs)
Probationary Certificate (issued with conditions for applicants guilty of unprofessional conduct)
Suspended (ordered by board or automatic upon certain convictions or out-of-state discipline)
Revoked (ordered by board or automatic upon certain sex offense convictions or specified felony convictions)
Volunteer/Unpaid Service (renewal fee waived when license is for sole purpose of providing voluntary, unpaid service)
Disabled Status (renewal fee waived for licensees unable to practice due to disability; may not practice)
Special Faculty Permit (for academically eminent foreign physicians at medical schools or academic medical centers)
Certificate of Registration under Section 2113 (for non-qualifying physicians offered full-time faculty positions)
Licensed Physicians from Mexico Program License (nonrenewable 3-year license)
license_status_types.quote: Every licensee is exempt from the payment of the renewal fee and requirement for continuing medical education if the licensee has applied to the Division of Licensing for a retired license. The holder of a retired license may not engage in the practice of medicine

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must: (1) have their school recognized by ECFMG or listed in the WFME/FAIMER World Directory; (2) be ECFMG certified; (3) complete 24 months (vs. 12 for US/Canadian graduates) of board-approved ACGME postgraduate training before licensure. Reciprocity applicants from foreign schools who have held an unrestricted out-of-state license for 4 years must also meet Section 2065 or 2135 requirements.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: if the applicant attended a foreign medical school approved by the board pursuant to Section 2084, an official Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) Certification Status Report submitted by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates confirming the graduate is ECFMG certified.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: before a physician's and surgeon's license may be issued, each applicant … shall show by evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has received credit for at least 12 months of board-approved postgraduate training for graduates of medical schools in the United States and Canada

pain_management_education_required.quote: All physicians and surgeons shall complete a mandatory continuing education course in the subjects of pain management and the treatment of terminally ill and dying patients. For the purposes of this section, this course shall be a one-time requirement of 12 credit hours

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An appropriate prior examination for prescribing purposes does not require a synchronous interaction and may be achieved through telehealth including a self-screening tool or questionnaire, provided the licensee complies with the appropriate standard of care. An eligible out-of-state physician and surgeon may practice medicine via telehealth in California for eligible patients with immediately life-threatening diseases or conditions.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An appropriate prior examination does not require a synchronous interaction between the patient and the licensee and can be achieved through the use of telehealth, including, but not limited to, a self-screening tool or a questionnaire, provided that the licensee complies with the appropriate standard of care.

telemedicine_license_available.quote: Notwithstanding any other law, an eligible out-of-state physician and surgeon may practice medicine in the state if the practice is limited to delivering health care via telehealth to an eligible patient.

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The supervising physician and surgeon may, at his or her discretion, in consultation with the nurse practitioner, certified nurse-midwife, or physician assistant, provide written instructions to be followed by a medical assistant in the performance of tasks or supportive services.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Investigating the circumstances of practice of any physician and surgeon where there have been any judgments, settlements, or arbitration awards requiring the physician and surgeon or his or her professional liability insurer to pay an amount in damages in excess of a cumulative total of thirty thousand dollars ($30,000)

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: a summary of any final hospital disciplinary actions that resulted in the termination or revocation of a licensee's hospital staff privileges for a medical disciplinary cause or reason

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The board may establish a Physician and Surgeon Health and Wellness Program for the early identification of, and appropriate interventions to support a physician and surgeon in his or her rehabilitation from, substance abuse to ensure that the physician and surgeon remains able to practice medicine in a manner that will not endanger the public health and safety

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: A licensee may be ordered to undergo a professional competency examination if, after investigation and review by a medical expert designated by the division or the Board of Podiatric Medicine, as applicable, there is reasonable cause to believe that the licensee is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients.

scope__license_status_types.quote: a physician and surgeon's certificate shall be automatically placed on inactive status during any period of time that the holder of the certificate is incarcerated after conviction of a misdemeanor.

Every licensee is exempt from the payment of the renewal fee and requirement for continuing medical education if the licensee has applied to the Division of Licensing for a retired license. The holder of a retired license may not engage in the practice of medicine
The board shall issue a nonrenewable three-year physician's and surgeon's license to each licensed physician from Mexico who meets the criteria set forth in this section.

An applicant for a physician's and surgeon's license or a physician's and surgeon's licensee who is otherwise eligible for that license but is unable to practice some aspects of medicine safely due to a disability may receive a limited license
The board, in its sole discretion, may issue a probationary physician's and surgeon's certificate to an applicant subject to terms and conditions
A licensee whose matter has been heard by an administrative law judge … may … Have his or her right to practice suspended for a period not to exceed one year upon order of the board.
Have his or her license revoked upon order of the board.

a person whose certificate has been surrendered while under investigation or while charges are pending or whose certificate has been revoked or suspended or placed on probation, may petition the board for reinstatement

any person who does not immediately qualify for a physician's and surgeon's certificate under this chapter and who is offered by the dean of an approved medical school, or dean or chief medical officer of an academic medical center, in this state a full-time faculty position may, after application to and approval by the board, be granted a certificate of registration to engage in the practice of medicine only to the extent that the practice is incident to and a necessary part of that person's duties
The renewal fee shall be waived for a physician and surgeon who certifies to the Medical Board of California that license renewal is for the sole purpose of providing voluntary, unpaid service.

The board shall issue a physician's and surgeon's certificate to an applicant who meets all of the following requirements: (a) The applicant holds an unlimited and unrestricted license as a physician and surgeon in another state

a graduate of an approved medical school may engage in the practice of medicine whenever and wherever required as a part of a postgraduate training program … The medical school graduate obtains a physician's and surgeon's postgraduate training license in accordance with Section 2064.5.
